capture.notes: Live Legrand/BTicino MyHomeServer1 (firmware 3.87.13 / WHO 13 device type 200 / WHO 1013 67.15.5.0) multi-session capture of 2026-10-24 recorded with OWNd master on a large home plant: WHO 4 zones 35-70 (setpoints as dimension 7, temperatures, humidity on 17 zones, actuators Z#1 / Z#2 and zone-0 actuators 0#1..0#4), about 100 WHO 1 points including four-digit area-0 points 0010-0015 and four-digit 0111-0515, WHO 2 general status. Status reads only, no commands. Purpose: the same facts as the F461 capture of 2026-10-23 on a second gateway family (OWNd 137, 139, 140, 141, 142; MyHOME 791-794, 798). The firmware oracle emulates MyHomeServer1 2.82.06; this unit runs 3.87.13, and *#13**12## returns a real MAC here (scrubbed) where the emulated 2.82.06 returns zeros (oracle PR 59). Timing: t is one monotonic axis over all runs (capture.runs[].t_offset is each run's start; t - t_offset is the time since that run's first frame); command-session rx rows carry t_estimated = true because the session hands the replies over as a batch with the ACK / NACK, so they are placed at their request's t; result.events_after holds only the event-session frames that arrived while the request was pending (tx.t <= t <= result.t).
